name: Riocabado (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle whose vertices are the upper hoist and fly corners and the middle of the lower edge, the triangle charged with three blue wavy stripes.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 13 February 2003 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 40 of 27 February 2003); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a white triangle with its vertices at the upper points of the hoist and fly and the middle of the lower edge, charged with three horizontal blue wavy stripes of 1/10 of the width, the rest red.

features.role: triangle from the upper corners to the middle of the lower edge
three wavy stripes on the triangle
